title: Active vs Passive Sentences
grammarTitle: Active vs Passive — Comparison and Practice
grammarNote:
Активный или пассивный — как выбрать?

АКТИВНЫЙ — когда деятель ВАЖЕН и ИЗВЕСТЕН:
"Neil Armstrong walked on the Moon in 1969." (Армстронг важен!)
"Professor Abenov teaches linguistics." (кто преподаёт важно)
✅ Прямая, живая речь: "I made a mistake." · "She fixed the problem."

ПАССИВНЫЙ — когда деятель НЕИЗВЕСТЕН или НЕВАЖЕН:
✅ "The vase was broken." (Кто сломал? Неизвестно.)
✅ "The exam results were published." (Кто — очевидно: администрация)
✅ "Petrol is made from oil." (как делают важнее кто)

ФОРМАЛЬНЫЙ стиль — предпочтительно пассив:
"The samples were analysed using spectrometry."
"It was concluded that the method was effective."

⚠️ Не злоупотребляй пассивом в разговоре!
Разговор: "Someone broke the window." (лучше)
Официально: "The window was broken during the night." (ок)

grammarExtra.title: Active vs Passive — choosing the right voice

rows.form: A: Kamila wrote this blog post.
rows.example: P: This blog post was written by Kamila.

rows.form: A: Scientists have found new evidence.
rows.example: P: New evidence has been found.

rows.form: A: The factory makes 10,000 cars a year.
rows.example: P: 10,000 cars are made a year.

rows.form: A: Nobody repaired the road.
rows.example: P: The road was not repaired.

rows.form: A: They are building a new sports hall.
rows.example: P: A new sports hall is being built.

rows.form: A: You must submit the form by Friday.
rows.example: P: The form must be submitted by Friday.

rows.form: The Aral Sea was affected by irrigation.
These books were published last year.
The decision was made by the board.
Many species were endangered by pollution.
The new law was introduced in 2022.
The stadium was opened in 2019.
500 trees will be planted this spring.
The results will be announced tomorrow.
New policies will be introduced next year.
The roads will be repaired in the summer.
The event will be organised by students.
The winner will be selected by a jury.
Plastic must be recycled whenever possible.
Phones should not be used in exams.
The environment can be protected.
Reports have to be submitted on time.
The rules must be followed by all students.
Errors should be corrected before submission.

grammarTip: Remember the passive forms across tenses: Present: is/are + pp | Past: was/were + pp | Future: will be + pp | Present Perfect: has/have been + pp | Modal: modal + be + pp. "By + agent" is optional — only add it when it's important to say WHO did the action.

exercises.text: Change to passive: "They discovered a new planet."
exercises.hint: Past passive: "A new planet" = new subject; "was discovered" = past passive.

exercises.text: Change to passive: "They will announce the results tomorrow."
opts: The results will be announced tomorrow.
exercises.correct: The results will be announced tomorrow.

exercises.text: Phones ___ (must not use) during the exam.
exercises.hint: Modal negative passive: must not be + used.

exercises.text: "A cure has been discovered" — what tense is this?
exercises.hint: has/have been + past participle = present perfect passive.

exercises.text: "The report was write by Kamila" is correct.
exercises.hint: Must use past participle: "The report was written by Kamila."

exercises.text: Which sentence is in the passive?
Change to passive: "They are building a new gym."
opts: A new gym is been built.
A new gym is being built.
exercises.correct: A new gym is being built.
exercises.hint: Present continuous passive: is/are being + past participle.
Passive is typical in formal, academic, and scientific contexts.

exercises.text: "Plastic must be recycled" is a modal passive.
exercises.hint: "must be recycled" = modal + be + past participle = modal passive ✅.

questions.hint: Future passive: will be + past participle.

questions.text: "500 trees will be plant next spring" is correct.
questions.hint: Correct: "500 trees will be planted next spring." (past participle = planted)

questions.text: The results ___ (announce) by the university next week.

questions.hint: has/have been + past participle = present perfect passive.

questions.text: English ___ (must learn) by all students at WKU.
Change to passive: "They are repairing the road."
questions.hint: Present continuous passive: is/are being + past participle.

questions.text: "By + agent" must always be included in a passive sentence.
questions.hint: "By + agent" is optional. Only include it when it adds important information.

questions.text: These books ___ (publish) by a Kazakh author in 2022.

opts: After seeing a documentary about plastic pollution
questions.correct: After seeing a documentary about plastic pollution
questions.hint: Statement 2: "He decided to join the Eco Club after seeing a documentary about plastic pollution."

questions.text: What is Kamila interested in organising?
opts: A recycling station near the dormitory
A clean-up day near the river
questions.correct: A recycling station near the dormitory
questions.hint: Statement 3: "She is interested in organising a recycling station near the dormitory."

questions.text: Zhibek says trees are planted every autumn by the Eco Club.
questions.hint: Statement 4: "trees are planted every spring" — not autumn.

opts: A large body of ice that moves slowly
questions.correct: A large body of ice that moves slowly
questions.hint: "Glacier" = a large mass of ice formed from compacted snow, moving slowly over land.

questions.text: Coal and oil are examples of fossil ___.
questions.hint: "Fossil fuels" = energy sources formed from ancient organisms: coal, oil, natural gas.

opts: To process used materials to make new products
questions.correct: To process used materials to make new products
questions.hint: "Recycle" = to convert waste into reusable material.
